sentences.text: Mr. I.N. Mehta, Senior Additional Advocate General, for the respondent.

Cr. Appeal No.208 of 2022 Appellant is a convict in case FIR No.268, dated 02.08.2020, registered at Police Station Balh, District Mandi, H.P., under Sections 376, 506 of Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text:
2. Mr. Surya Chauhan, Advocate, submits that earlier, Mr. Tara Singh Chauhan, Advocate, was representing the appellant, however, after his designation as Senior Advocate, his Power of Attorney filed on behalf of appellant stands determined and, therefore, appellant was asked to supply fresh Power of Attorney, but instead thereof, family members of appellant have taken the brief from the office of Mr. Tara Singh Chauhan, Advocate and therefore, he is not in a position to contest the appeal on behalf of the appellant.
3. Appellant is stated to be in detention.
However, information is not available either with Mr. Surya Chauhan, Advocate or with Mr, I.N. Mehta, learned Senior Additional Advocate General about the jail in which, appellant has been detained.
Therefore, Director General (Prison) is directed to .
communication of passing of this order to the appellant with further direction to him to make arrangements by engaging lawyer for his representation
. Needful be done well before the next date of hearing.

4. Further, respondent/State is directed to place on record relevant documents to substantiate the compliance of the order about informing the appellant with respect to next date of hearing and concerned Jail Superintendent shall facilitate the engagement of counsel by the appellant as permissible under Law.
List for further orders on 11.09.2025.
(Vivek Singh Thakur) Judge (Sushil Kukreja) Judge 6th August, 2025 (reena)
